title: Organize Your Poms In Clo | Clo Feature Deep Dive
description:
The new update to our POM feature in CLO 2024.2 allows you to organize your POMs into folders and easily show or hide specific grading sizes. Check out other new features here: https://clo3d.com/en/clo/features

Questions? Comment below or ask in our CLO discord server: https://support.clo3d.com/hc/en-us/articles/7814962429977-How-can-I-join-CLO-Discord-
